row_semantics: Each row represents a specific direction light status subscription request for different vehicle directions (right front, left rear, right rear).

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interface parameters for subscribing to the status of various direction lights (right front, left rear, right rear) in a vehicle. It specifies the interface name, parameter name, and possible status values (OFF, ON, Unknown) for each instance ID.
